assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: transparent full-body pixel-art combat character skin for a children's fantasy RPG.
Edit target: image 1, the existing approved character. Preserve EXACT character identity: face design, hair color and hairstyle, clothing design and colors, equipment motifs, warm dark-brown outlines, friendly storybook expression language, approximate 3-head chibi proportions and pixel cluster size. Change pose and expression into ACTIVE COMBAT. Do not redesign into a generic glossy anime character.
Supporting references images 2–4: game's canonical pixel edge density (pumpkin sword, witch mantle, moon charm), not objects or Halloween content.
Style: clearly visible coarse square pixel clusters on approximately 128x128 logical grid, crisp stepped edges, 24–32 principal colors, 1 logical pixel warm dark-brown outline, 3–4 flat shades per material, NO blur, smooth airbrushing, texture or dense fine detail. Large source image only as visibly coarse pixel-art enlargement.
Composition: ONE human character in a strong dynamic attacking action, three-quarter front view, ENTIRE body including hair, both feet, weapon and attack accent inside a square 1:1 canvas with 8% safety margin. Strong readable action silhouette with clear limb anatomy. Genuine transparent alpha background; no drawn checkerboard, scene, floor, shadow oval, card, lettering or frame. Character alone with a SMALL local attack accent only, no enemies or companions. No blood, injuries, gore or frightening violence. Maintain identity and costume.
Character: 花風のまほう使い, human girl with chestnut low twin bunches tied coral ribbons, big warm brown eyes, sage green cape with cream flower clasp, ivory blouse, coral skirt, cream leggings, brown boots, tan pouch, wooden staff topped by a cream five-petal flower. KEEP all of those details and palette from target.
New pose: a decisive spellcasting attack instead of greeting. Wide low grounded stance, front knee deeply bent and rear leg braced, torso twisting into a forward thrust. Grip the flower staff firmly in BOTH hands, lower hand near hip and upper hand near chest, staff tilted diagonally toward upper right so the flower head is aimed forward. Cape, skirt edge and twin bunches sweep BACK in the opposite direction. Focused determined brows and spirited open-mouth battle cry, face still charming. A compact mint-green and cream pixelated crescent with 3–5 loose petal shapes bursts just beyond the flower staff head; crisp flat pixels, no translucent broad glow or particles across the image. Keep the spell accent small enough that the character remains dominant, all elements fit canvas. Both hands must clearly wrap around the shaft, no duplicate staff and no waving hand. Do not just tilt the standing sprite: change the entire body gesture into a convincing action silhouette.
